skill_name: Analyze the environmental impact of a given type of transport
workflow: Air transport has significant environmental impacts, due to its contribution to air pollution, climate change, and noise. It is estimated that air transport contributes around 3.5% of all global anthropogenic carbon dioxide emissions. In addition, aircraft engines emit other gases, such as water vapor, nitrogen oxides, and sulfur oxides, as well as particulate matter.
